voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Moscow, fifteen eighty-four. Ivan the Terrible dies. Legend says his library lay hidden beneath the Kremlin.
Greek and Latin manuscripts, said to have come from Constantinople with a Byzantine princess, in fourteen seventy-two.
A list reported in the eighteen-hundreds named all one hundred forty-two books of Livy's history of Rome. Only thirty-five survive.
The list is lost, and may be a forgery. In nineteen thirty-three, an archaeologist dug beneath a Kremlin tower. He found passages. No books.
Some say it burned. Some, that it never existed. No trace has ever been found.
